title: For any given integer a > 0, are there infinitely many primes p such that a^{p − 1} ≡ 1 (mod p^{2})
exact_target: Does every positive integer base have infinitely many Wieferich primes? The base one case holds for all primes.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 9400172 (AMR-093-0172). CC BY 4.0.
